en: How do you say it in Spanish?
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE transparent square vocabulary illustration matching reference 1 approved rounded flat cartoon, huge white oval eyes, oversized heads, chunky hands, solid bright turquoise/amber/coral/navy/cream, minimal details, almost no outlines.
